sets.s: “In order to gain a competitive advantage over our competitors, the company’s marketing budget must be increased.”
i: The company’s marketing budget is failing the company.
N

It is assumed in the statement that the marketing budget does not offer a competitive advantage over competitors, but it does not assume that the current marketing budget is failing the company, since company performance is not mentioned, making the correct answer “Assumption Not Made”.
The current marketing budget does not provide a competitive advantage.
M

Because increasing the size of the marketing budget is required to provide the company with a competitive advantage, it can be assumed that the current marketing budget does not provide a competitive advantage. Therefore, the correct answer is “Assumption Made”.
The company’s competitors currently have a competitive advantage over the company.
N

Although the company is not currently stated to have a competitive advantage over other competitors, it cannot be assumed that competitors have any competitive advantage over the company, based on the information in the statement. Therefore, the correct answer is “Assumption Not Made”.

sets.s: “As the standard of living continues to improve in China, Chinese companies will eventually lose business to countries which pay their workers lower wages and can therefore offer lower production costs.”
i: Chinese companies are paying higher wages than competitor countries.
N

The statement assumes that in the future, once the standard of living has improved even further, China will be paying higher wages than in competitor countries. However, it cannot be assumed that wages are currently higher than in competitor countries, making the correct answer “Assumption Not Made”.
Low production costs will help to attract business.
M

The statement assumes that competitor countries will win business due to lower production costs and that China will lose business due to high production costs (due to high wages). Therefore, it can be assumed that low production costs can help attract business, making the correct answer “Assumption Made”.
Worker’s wages in China depend on the national standard of living.
M

The statement assumes that improved standards of living will lead to an increase in wages. Therefore, the worker’s wages are dependent on the national standard of living, making the correct answer “Assumption Made”.

sets.s: “Individuals of all ages need to ensure they engage in at least 30 minutes of exercise per day, at least 5 days per week.”
i: 20 minutes of exercise per day is insufficient.
M

The statement claims that individuals need to engage in at least 30 minutes of exercise per day. Therefore undertaking 20 minutes of exercises is an insufficient amount of exercise, making the correct answer “Assumption Made”.
Exercise is essential for maintaining good posture.
N

Although the statement assumes that individuals need to undertake exercise, it does not assume that the reason for exercise is for posture benefits. Because the statement does not directly state the reason for engaging in exercise, the correct answer is “Assumption Not Made”.
Individuals need to be aware of the amount of exercise they undertake.
M

It is stated that individuals need to ensure they engage in exercise, assuming that it is the responsibility of the individual to get at least 30 minutes of exercise, at least 5 days per week. Therefore the correct answer is “Assumption Made”.

sets.s: “When making job applications, it is essential that application forms are completed clearly, honestly and comprehensively in order to maximise your chances of getting hired.”
i: Honesty is an important part of a successful job application.
M

It is stated that completing application forms honestly is essential in maximising your chances of getting hired. Since getting hired is the successful outcome of a job application, the correct answer is “Assumption Made”.
A well written application form guarantees a successful job application.
N

Writing an application form clearly, honestly and comprehensively will only help to maximise your chances of getting hired, rather than guarantee a successful job application. Because it is not a guarantee, the correct answer is “Assumption Not Made”.
Applicants with unclear application forms will not get hired.
N

Based on the statement, having an unclear application form will not maximise your chances of getting hired, but does not necessarily exclude you from getting hired. Because a clear application form can only help maximise your chances, the correct answer is “Assumption Not Made”.
